Can any Vu motherboard be fitted to another Vu 4K TV?
No. Board revision, panel compatibility and the required software must match. Choosing a board only by brand and resolution can leave the television unusable or create another fault.
Does a frozen Vu startup logo mean the saved apps must be erased?
A reset may be one diagnostic option, but it is not the only one and can remove saved accounts or settings. The exact model and failure should be reviewed before applying a recovery procedure.
Is a home visit possible for a large Vu in Greater Noida?

An appointment can start at the installation address, subject to access. Some jobs require tools or workspace beyond the home setup. Any recommendation to move the set should follow an explanation of that requirement.
